# Product direction

Use `reference.md` section `06` for direction, not current DSL truth. Current
behavior is owned by code, tests, section `07`, and feature status.

Priorities: shared geometry/text correctness and neutral schemas; one pipeline
for every format; renderer-neutral routing; WASM/PptxGenJS PPTX boundary; shared
APIs for preview/editor work. Mode and format remain independent. Do not
describe planned 2.5D, topology, V2, or editor work as implemented.
